text:
Ashwin: Quick sync on "degradation score" for precision fallbacks — we need very cheap runtime signals to decide switching from FP8 -> INT8/4bit.

Maria: Constraints: <=1% p99 extra latency, explainable, and per-route tunables.

Leo: My draft: compute 3 core signals per-route: embedding_shift (cosine to rolling centroid EWMA), token_ll_delta (avg token logprob drop vs baseline window), and coverage_gap (n-gram overlap drop to golden samples). Combine into a single Degradation Score.

Olivia: embedding_shift should use reservoir sample + centroid and EWMA phi=0.92; ignore responses shorter than 8 tokens.

Kai: For token_ll_delta: use cached baseline LM logits over prompts (approx via prefix cache) to avoid full rerun. For low-cost, compute over first 16 tokens only.

Ashwin: Combine formula suggestion:
```
// per-route state: centroid, ewma_sim, baseline_stats
emb_sim = cos(embed(resp), centroid)
ewma_sim = alpha*ewma_sim + (1-alpha)*emb_sim
ll_drop = baseline_avg_ll - avg_ll(resp[:16])
coverage = 1 - ngram_overlap(resp, route_refs)
degradation = A*(baseline_sim - ewma_sim) + B*ll_drop + C*coverage
if degradation > route_thresh and cool_ok:
  request_fallback("int8", reason="degradation")
```

Maria: Need cooldown/backoff; default cooldown 15m, exponential backoff x2, cap 4h.

Leo: Telemetry: include quant_profile, model, route_id, customer_id (hashed), sample_seed, last_5_metric_values (as list).

Olivia: Shadow eval: send 0.5% traffic to an offline INT8/4bit shadow and compute true quality delta (BLEU/EM/embedding sim) asynchronously. Use that to calibrate A,B,C monthly.

Kai: Also add a deployment-sensitivity flag: if a deploy happened within last 30m for model or route, force conservative mode (no auto-fallbacks) — reduce false positives from prompt changes.

SRE-bot: ALERT: If a single route triggers >6 fallbacks in rolling 1h window, auto-page oncall and create ticket.

Ashwin: Cost/latency tradeoffs: prefer async embed compute and reuse cached prompt embeddings. If embed unavailable, skip embedding signal and rely on ll_drop+coverage.

Maria: UX: two customer-facing knobs: "fallback_sensitivity" (low/med/high) and "operational_stability" (aggressive/stable) — map to thresholds and cooldowns.

Leo: Edge cases: cold-start routes — mark as "calibration" for first 1000 requests and start with conservative thresholds. Also capture deploy tags to correlate.

Olivia: Implementation plan:
- PR1 (eng-ml): runtime telemetry + centroid store
- PR2 (eng-ml): fast token_ll proxy and prefix-cache hooks
- PR3 (eng-platform): shadow harness + calibration job
- PR4 (product/frontend): customer knob UI and audit logs

Kai: I'll add perf tests for proxy LL computation and ensure <0.5% p99 latency added in hotpath.

Ashwin: Action items assigned. Timeline: 2wk spike for metrics + 6wk iterative rollout with shadow calibration.

Maria: Good. Keep audit trail and include human-review path for enterprise by default.

Leo: I'll attach an example dashboard JSON in the PR.

Olivia: WIP branch link when ready. :thumbsup:

Ashwin: Thanks everyone — post updates as short notes in PRs.
